Node v25.9.0 at about 2026-10-21T10:51Z decodes the reported bytes 53 41 56 45 31 30 E2 80 8B to code points 53,41,56,45,31,30,200b. trim().toUpperCase() of that string is not 'SAVE10'. U+200B fails /\s/u, so it is not WhiteSpace and String.prototype.trim keeps it. It matches /\p{Cf}/u and /\p{Default_Ignorable_Code_Point}/u, and removing Default_Ignorable code points yields exactly 'SAVE10'. The defect exists exactly as reported, and the fix's normalization is correct for the reported input. Earlier, at 08:00Z, the drill's own calculateQuote on origin/main efb7c80 returned invalid (8000) for 'SAVE10' + U+200B and applied (7200) for 'SAVE10'.
